name: Camping Riffler
beschreibung: Camping Riffler is located in St. Ulrich am Pillersee in the district of Kitzbühel, surrounded by the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The facility offers pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as simple sanitary facilities. Guests can reach the village center and the ski slope in just a few minutes. The atmosphere is quiet and family-friendly, with direct access to hiking trails and ski slopes.
